**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat` PR: it merges at the next cut.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the posted Agie job files (SBL) and the offset that the clearance check uses.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4424#issuecomment-7228202625

## What looks good

- One source gives the wire. `Quality::wire()` writes `ID_THREAD` on the piece and on each work (`crates/post/src/agie_setup/piece.rs:76`, `:175`) and the wire in the operator review.
- The clearance and miter checks use the rough offset of the selected quality (`crates/post/src/agie/contour.rs:133`).
- Each new `match` arm is exhaustive. No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` is in the new non-test code.
- The refusals come before a file is written:
  - other heights: `punch_setup` and `SetupError::UnqualifiedCobraHeight`;
  - a die and an open cutoff: `export_punch_with_review`;
  - a group and a DXF arc punch: `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:162`;
  - a group with mixed conditions: the existing check at `posting_agie.rs:153`.
- The Berco output is unchanged. No recorded program changed. "Goldens moved: None" is correct: the diff has no `*.nc`, `*.cl`, golden or `examples/` file.
- The new tests join the existing suites (`agie::cobra_tests` in the post lib, `agie_native/cobra.rs` in the app). No new test binary.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2986-agie-cobra-40.md` has the required parts. The blocking issue #2984 is closed.
- The body has `Changelog:`, the pins, the mutations, "Not exercised" and `Fixes #2986`. No process file, dependency, `build.rs`, script or workflow changed. No `crates/ui` file changed, thus no screenshots are necessary.

## Results merged with main

Built and tested locally on host `egg`, in `.claude/worktrees/review-4424`. The tree is the PR head `7a68cb5b3` merged with `upstream/main` `4d891498e` (a clean merge). No GitHub runner was used.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 360 steps, 0 failed (run in four parts because of a time limit on each command; each step ran one time and passed) |
| `post suites: lib` | 185 passed, with the 4 `agie::cobra_tests` pins |
| `post suites: script_edm` (`agie_safe_setup`, `agie_inspection`) | ok |
| `app suites: agie_native` | 44 passed, with the 4 `cobra::` pins |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | ok |
| `app suites: wire_post`, `wire_post_alias` | ok |
| `ui build` and the 6 `ui suites` of the plan | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` or a fixture directory, and no importer code.

## Mutations (run by this review, each one restored)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| A. The work writes `ID_THREAD` "Berco Cut 0.25" (`piece.rs:175`); the piece keeps the quality wire | red: `cobra_cut_d_sets_the_wire_and_quality_of_a_40_mm_punch` |
| B. `prepare_with_reach` uses the CCB030 rough offset (`contour.rs:133`) | red: `cobra_cut_d_bounds_the_cut_with_its_own_rough_offset` |
| C. `quality_of("AGIE_COBRA_RA070")` gives `Ccd030` (`posting_agie.rs:36`) | red: `a_cobra_condition_requests_its_quality_and_wire_on_a_40_mm_punch` and `a_cobra_condition_refuses_a_group_an_arc_punch_a_die_and_a_cutoff` |
| D. `encode_side` reads the CCB030 offsets (`agie_setup.rs:208`) | red: `the_setup_encoder_holds_cobra_cut_d_to_40_mm` and `cobra_cut_d_sets_the_wire_and_quality_of_a_40_mm_punch` |

After the restore, the tree was clean, and the post pins (4 of 4) and `agie_native` (44 of 44) were green again.

## Goldens

No golden moved, thus there is no line to compare. The SBL pin compares the full Cobra SBL with the Berco 40 mm SBL after two exact replacements (the quality line and the two wire values). Mutations A and D show that this comparison catches a wrong byte.

## Heavy lanes

Not run. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches 75 `app heavy` steps. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives no heavy step to a `P6` PR. No heavy record names this head.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge, not blocking)

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:37` - The post dialog always shows "AGIE_QN2 · ... · Berco Cut 0.25 mm · ... Fine Ra 0.30 µm". With a Cobra condition this line names the wrong wire and finish. The line was already wrong for `AGIE_BERCO_RA035`, and the PR body states it under "Not exercised". The posted files and the operator review are correct. Suggested `P3` (a misleading message).
2. `crates/app/src/operation/agie_profile.rs:199` and `:213` - Two refusals name `AGIE_QN2` for each condition. They can name the selected condition. Suggested `P7`.
3. `crates/app/tests/agie_native.rs` has 415 lines (413 before this PR). The file was already above 400 lines. Suggested `P7`: move one more group of tests into a submodule.

## Questions / notes

- No control import confirmed the wire name `Cobra Cut D 0.25` or the quality names `CCD030` and `CCD070`. The PR body says so, and the operator review tells the operator to verify the wire and to stop if TECCUT differs. The decision file can also say that the wire name follows the pattern of `Berco Cut 0.25`.
- The host has no GPU. The UI suites of this plan passed here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
